mapper.insert: INSERT INTO note_comment (id, note_id, build_username, like_num, build_date, reply_id, reply_username, content, is_deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{noteId}, #{buildUsername}, 0, #{buildDate}, #{replyId}, #{replyUsername}, #{content}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT nc.* FROM note_comment nc WHERE nc.note_id = #{noteId} AND nc.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY nc.build_date ASC

SELECT nc.*, CASE WHEN ncl.username IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as isLikedByCurrentUser FROM note_comment nc LEFT JOIN note_comment_like ncl ON nc.id = ncl.comment_id AND ncl.username = #{username} WHERE nc.note_id = #{noteId} AND nc.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY nc.build_date ASC
SELECT * FROM note_comment WHERE id = #{commentId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
